title: the panel's brand, contract version 1
description: The installation's brand, which every page of the panel shares as the prop brand (PRD 13.4): the product name and the logos the application sets in cbox-cms.panel.branding, or Cbox CMS without them. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\PanelBrand, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace. No theme or addon sets any of it.

login.description: The brand image the login page shows, the logo unless the application sets one of its own for the login page, or null when it sets neither.

logo.description: The logo the shell's header shows, or null when the application sets none.

name.description: The product name: the application's, or Cbox CMS when it sets none.

logo.description: An image in a light and a dark version, each the address of a file the panel serves from its own origin, and the text that stands for it.

alt.description: The image's alternative text, which a screen reader announces.

dark.description: The address of the version shown in the dark mode.

light.description: The address of the version shown in the light mode.
